verdict.rationale: Reflect documents import support for Evernote (ENEX), Roam (JSON), and Markdown files, matching most of the story, but Notion import is not listed among supported sources — only Apple Notes, Evernote, Roam, Markdown, and Workflowy are supported. There is no evidence describing how well structure, internal links, or attachments are preserved during these imports. Missing for 10: Notion import support, and documentation/evidence of link/attachment/structure fidelity during import.
